observations.observation: Original's page title is '.:Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek :.', with the dotted-colon decoration and an empty html lang. The AI-built page's title is 'Alpine Everest Expedition and Treks' and its lang is 'en'.

tags.value: changed: decorated title and empty lang become plain title and lang en

observations.observation: Both pages put a fixed-width centered content column on a 1440px viewport. Original's column is about 980px wide (x≈230–1210) with square corners. The AI-built page's is about 1068px (x≈186–1254), drawn as a white card with rounded corners.

tags.value: changed: 980px column becomes centered 1060px column
changed: square corners become small rounding

observations.observation: Both pages show a full-bleed scenic background behind the column: a teal sky running down to sand, with black grass silhouettes. Both put the footer on a black or near-black area (original body bg rgb(0,0,0); AI-built rgb(13,15,14)).

tags.value: kept: scenic teal sky and sand background with black footer area

observations.observation: Original uses no grid or flex: layout comes from 2 tables, floats and positioning (display_grid 0, display_flex 0). The AI-built page uses 5 grid and 4 flex containers and no tables.

tags.value: changed: tables and floats become flex plus grid

observations.observation: Original has no HTML5 semantic landmarks: header, nav, main, section, aside and footer all count 0, and the markup is div/ul/li-heavy (44 div, 13 ul, 45 li). The AI-built page uses header 1, nav 3, main 1, section 2, aside 1 and footer 1, with only 7 divs.

tags.value: changed: divs and lists become header nav main sections footer

observations.observation: Original has three h1s ('Namaste, Welcome to Alpine Everest', 'Gallery', 'Products'), all 16px bold, and no h2. The AI-built page has one h1 ('“Namaste”'), with 'Gallery' and 'Products' as 16px h2s. It also has two empty h2s before the h1 in DOM order.

tags.value: changed: multiple h1s and no h2 becomes structured h1 h2

observations.observation: The main greeting heading differs. Original's h1 is 16px bold Verdana and two-toned: 'Namaste,' in navy rgb(39,66,120), 'Welcome to Alpine Everest' in olive green. The AI-built page's h1 is just '“Namaste”' at 32px bold Georgia in dark teal rgb(31,76,88), followed by a separate italic serif lead line, 'Welcome to Alpine Everest.', in muted grey-teal.

tags.value: changed: small two-tone verdana h1 becomes large serif h1 with lead line

observations.observation: Original sets almost everything in Verdana (236 elements), with Arial and one Times New Roman element. The AI-built page pairs Georgia serif (103) for headings, brand and body copy with system-ui sans (41) for nav, sidebar, form and contact details.

tags.value: changed: verdana becomes georgia and system-ui pairing

observations.observation: Original's intro copy is small (about 11px), justified, gray rgb(102,102,102) text with line-height 'normal'. The AI-built page's intro is serif at about 16px with a 26.4px line height, in dark blue-grey rgb(36,50,58).

tags.attribute: body text size and line height
tags.value: changed: 11px justified normal line height becomes 16px 1.65

observations.observation: Both pages put the welcome photo collage (welcome-img.jpg, 176×260, three tilted overlapping trekker photos) beside the intro text. In the original the collage sits on the right of the paragraph; on the AI-built page it sits on the left, with the text in a 536px column to its right.

tags.value: changed: collage moves from right to left of intro text

observations.observation: Original's palette is navy text rgb(22,38,74), mid gray rgb(102,102,102), cyan links rgb(0,153,204), white panels and pale teal rgb(162,212,213). The AI-built page uses a teal family: dark teal rgb(31,76,88) for headings and links, mid teal rgb(47,111,126) for accents and the button, blue-grey body text rgb(36,50,58), and white or pale blue-white surfaces.

tags.value: changed: navy gray and cyan becomes teal family

observations.observation: Original's header is a white block holding a large logo graphic with 'Alpine Everest Group' and serif tagline lines ('Expedition & Trek', 'Import & Export'), plus a large empty white area. The AI-built page's header is a dark slate band with a small logo JPG on a white tile, a white serif brand name and an uppercase tracked tagline ('EXPEDITION & TREKS · KATHMANDU, NEPAL').

tags.value: changed: large white logo block becomes dark slate band with small logo
changed: large logo graphic becomes small logo with text wordmark

observations.observation: On the original, two header images (aimg2.jpg and aimg7.jpg) fail to load and overlap as broken-image icons, leaving a roughly 700×290px blank area. The AI-built page has no image overlaps or broken header images.

tags.value: dropped: broken thumbnail images with alt text

observations.observation: Both pages have a top nav with the same four links: Home, About Us, Testimonials, Contact Us. Original shows them as text links with thick blue-violet underlines, centered on a light patterned band. The AI-built page shows them as grey-white folder tabs with rounded tops, bold sans text, aligned bottom-right in the header and joining the card.

tags.value: changed: underlined text links become folder tabs aligned right

observations.observation: Both pages have a left sidebar link list with hairline dividers covering tour categories (Adventure Activities, Destination, Special Packages, Services, Gallery, Plan a trip), and a second list of product categories (Pashmina, Garments, Handicrafts).

tags.value: kept: left sidebar category link lists

observations.observation: The AI-built page's sidebar links carry small teal triangular bullets and are about 43px tall in sans-serif dark teal. Original's sidebar items are plain small Verdana links.

tags.value: changed: plain small links become teal bulleted taller links

observations.observation: Both pages render the sidebar titles 'Featured Tours' and 'Contact Information' as 248×94 PNG images of a yellow torn-paper banner, not as text.

tags.value: kept: yellow torn-paper png banners as titles

observations.observation: Original's sidebar 'Products' label is small plain purple-blue link-style text. The AI-built page's 'PRODUCTS' and 'REFER A FRIEND' labels are small bold tracked uppercase teal p elements.

tags.value: changed: plain link-style labels become bold uppercase teal labels

observations.observation: The AI-built page's sidebar is split into separate rounded panel boxes, each with a thin pale border, a faint hatch texture and an off-white fill. Original's sidebar is one continuous white column with square corners.

tags.value: added: separate rounded bordered panel boxes

observations.observation: Both pages have a recommend/refer-a-friend form with three text inputs and a 'Send' control. Original uses pale-teal rgb(162,212,213) inputs with small gray labels and a default-looking input-type Send (buttons 0). The AI-built page uses white bordered inputs with a small radius, placeholders instead of labels, and a real button element with a solid teal rgb(47,111,126) fill, white text and a 5px radius.

tags.value: changed: pale teal inputs with default send become white inputs with real button
changed: default input send becomes solid teal rounded button

observations.observation: Both pages list the same contact channels, including Skype and MSN. Original sets them as plain small text lines separated by br, with no labels or link styling. The AI-built page uses a dl with bold teal dt labels and dd values, an address element, and the email as an underlined link.

tags.value: changed: plain text lines become dl with labels and email link

observations.observation: Original's Gallery is a single horizontal strip of 150×150 thumbnails in a thin-bordered box, laid out for 10 items but clipped after four. The AI-built page shows Gallery thumbnails in a 6-column wrapping grid (two rows), with no clipping.

tags.value: changed: clipped single strip becomes six-column wrapping grid

observations.observation: Original's Products strip is clipped and irregularly spaced: images are 96–132px wide at uneven offsets, carry blue caption bars ('Skirt -03'), and include broken-image slots. The AI-built Products section uses the same 6-column grid as the Gallery, with uniform 113×148 cells and no captions.

tags.value: changed: irregular captioned strip becomes uniform six-column grid

observations.observation: Original's thumbnails are distinct photos (various gallery shots, product photos of tops and skirts). On the AI-built page all 20 thumbnails use the same thumb.png of a pashmina shawl, so Gallery and Products look identical.

tags.value: changed: distinct photos become one repeated placeholder thumbnail

observations.observation: AI-built thumbnails are framed like photo prints, with a white border and soft drop shadow (box_shadows 19). Original's thumbnails have no shadows (box_shadows 0).

tags.value: added: white border and drop shadow photo-print frames

observations.observation: Both pages end the Gallery and Products blocks with a 'more' link. Original uses a cyan rgb(0,153,204) 'more' at the bottom right. The AI-built page uses left-aligned, underlined, bold teal 'More photos →' and 'More products →' with an arrow glyph.

tags.value: changed: cyan right more link becomes underlined link with text arrow

observations.observation: The AI-built page divides the Gallery and Products sections with a horizontal hairline rule above each heading.

tags.value: added: hairline rules above section headings

observations.observation: Original has two embedded plugin areas (object/embed, likely Flash) that render as "Couldn't load plugin.", leaving a large empty band. The AI-built page has no object or embed elements.

tags.value: dropped: failed flash plugin blocks

observations.observation: Both pages have a single-line footer of small white text on black with a 2010 copyright for Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek. Original's is left-aligned with the content column and not in a footer element. The AI-built page's is centered, in a footer element, on a full-width near-black band.

tags.value: changed: left-aligned text becomes centered footer band

observations.observation: Original has no CSS effects: all 241 elements have 0 radius, with 0 shadows and 0 transitions. The AI-built page has 23 elements with 1–7px radius, 8 with 8–15px, 19 box shadows and 18 transitions. Neither page uses gradients, blur, animations or transforms.

tags.value: changed: flat becomes radii shadows and transitions
changed: square corners become small rounding

observations.observation: Original's styling is legacy: 38 inline style attributes, a font element, 4 external stylesheets and 16 scripts. The AI-built page has 4 inline styles, no scripts and no external stylesheets, with all CSS in one style element. Neither uses Tailwind-like classes (original 89 uses / 9 unique; AI-built 23 / 14).

tags.value: changed: legacy markup becomes single inline style

observations.observation: Original has 0 aria attributes, and 20 of its 23 images lack alt text. On the AI-built page every image has alt text (mostly generic and numbered, e.g. 'Gallery photo 20'), and it has 8 aria attributes. On the original, gallery images also load from URLs with resize query strings.

tags.value: changed: missing alts become generic descriptive alts
changed: aria attributes on components

observations.observation: Original's head carries only the Content-Type and google-site-verification meta tags. The AI-built page carries charset and viewport. Neither has JSON-LD.

tags.value: changed: verification meta becomes charset and viewport

observations.observation: Both pages carry short copy of about the same length (192 vs 183 words) with no exclamation marks. Original contains one emoji-like character and no em dash; the AI-built page has no emoji and one em dash. The AI-built page is taller (1676px vs 1363px).

tags.value: changed: short copy without exclamation marks
changed: shorter page becomes slightly taller page

observations.observation: Both pages use a warm, service-oriented tone ('Namaste', first-person plural) under one brand that covers trekking/tours and trade goods (pashmina, garments, handicrafts).

tags.value: kept: warm service-oriented namaste tone

observations.observation: Both pages use two columns: a left sidebar (original about 260–270px, AI-built a 260px aside) and a wider main column (original about 660px, AI-built about 736px).

tags.value: kept: left sidebar plus wider main column

observations.observation: On both pages the sidebar and main column end at different heights. On the original the sidebar's white stops at about y=1290 while the main column continues. On the AI-built page the sidebar (about 1400px) runs longer than the main content, leaving empty white beside it.

tags.value: kept: sidebar and main column unequal heights
